name: visionvault
description: Privacy-preserving browser vision agent — local PII detection and redaction, cloud planning over a sanitized view (SIH PS 26171).

scripts.test: node eval/test-source-hygiene.js && node eval/test-panel-wiring.js && node eval/test-prompt-scrubber.js && node eval/test-pdf-scrubber.js && node eval/test-screen-classifier.js && node eval/test-batch-automation.js && node eval/test-advanced-features.js && node eval/test-checklist-grounding.js && node eval/test-mcp-server.js && node eval/test-vision-pipeline.js && node eval/test-coordinate-mapping.js && node eval/test-task-planner.js && node eval/test-agent-guard.js && node eval/test-privacy-firewall.js && node eval/test-vault-lock.js && node eval/test-pii-patterns.js && node eval/test-demo-portal.js
scripts.build:firefox: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('extension', 'extension-firefox', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('extension/manifest.firefox.json', 'extension-firefox/manifest.json'); console.log('[OK] Firefox extension prepared in extension-firefox/ (load via about:debugging)')"
scripts.demo: node -e "console.log('VisionVault demo workflow: 1) npm run server 2) Load extension/ in Chrome or npm run build:firefox 3) open a form page and run a task 4) review the redacted preview before execution'); console.log('For full setup see START-HERE.md and SIH-READY.md');"
scripts.sih:setup: npm run build:firefox && npm run server
